summary: Temporary restricted area for drones at Tilbury, Essex, up to 1,200 feet, between 0900 and 1700, within 1 nautical mile.
text:
RESTRICTED AREA (TEMPORARY) INSTALLED FOR UAS ONLY (TILBURY,
ESSEX) WI 1NM RADIUS OF 512706N 0002149E DOES NOT APPLY TO ANY UAS
FLYING IN ACCORDANCE WITH EXCEPTIONS STATED IN THE BRIEFING
SHEET, BFS 139/2026. FURTHER DETAILS WWW.NATS.AERO/AIS. 
RESTRICTION OF FLYING REGULATIONS MADE UNDER ARTICLE 239 OF AIR
NAV ORDER 2016. AR-2026-9328/01.
